chunks: O my Allah! I am the first who leaned (towards Thee) and who heard and responded (to the call of Islam).
No one preceded me in prayer (salat) except the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family).
ai.seo_question: Who was the first person to pray after the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: This supplication underscores Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) unique precedence in faith, affirming his status as the first male adult to embrace Islam and pray, a fact central to Shia arguments for his immediate succession. By noting that only the Prophet preceded him, the text highlights his unparalleled spiritual readiness and intimate connection to the divine call, reinforcing his legitimacy as the first rightful Caliph.

en.sayed-ali-raza: O my Allāh! I am the first who leaned (towards Thee) and who heard and responded (to the call of Islam).
No one preceded me in prayer (ṣalāt) except the Prophet.
